question: Who among the following became India's youngest Olympic medallist by winning a bronze in wrestling at the 2024 Paris Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aman Sehrawat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aman Sehrawat** became India's youngest Olympic medallist by winning a **bronze in wrestling** at the **2024 Paris Paralympics**.
 
• His achievement is notable because of his **young age** and the **prestigious platform** where he won the medal.
 
• Wrestling is a **popular sport in India**, and winning an Olympic medal is a significant accomplishment.
 
• Aman Sehrawat’s victory highlights the **potential and talent** of young athletes in India.
 
• This achievement brings **pride and inspiration** to aspiring wrestlers and athletes in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sumit Antil**__

 __
 
• **Sumit Antil** is a prominent Indian Paralympian who won a **gold medal in javelin throw** at the **2020 Tokyo Paralympics**.
 
• He set a new **world record** in the F64 category with his throw.
 
 
 
• **Vinod Kumar**__
 __
 
• **Vinod Kumar** is an Indian para-athlete who competes in the **discus throw** event.
 
• He initially won a **bronze medal** in the F52 event at the **2020 Tokyo Paralympics**, which was later disqualified due to classification issues.
 
 
 
• **Praveen Kumar**__
 
 
• **Praveen Kumar** is an Indian para high-jumper who won a **silver medal** in the T64 category at the **2020 Tokyo Paralympics**.
 
• He set a new **Asian record** with his jump.
